newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt housing firm pays out 10.90 pound.
newsitem.headline: Egypt housing firm pays out 10.90 pound.

text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development said on Saturday it was paying an annual dividend of 10.90 pounds a share for 1995/6.
Company sources said last week that the general assembly on December 25 approved a dividend of 10.00 pounds but a company official said on Saturday that this was incorrect.
The official said the company board had not yet decided on a shareholders' request that the company make a one-for-two free share issue.
Heliopolis Housing nearly doubled net after-tax profits in 1995/96, which ended on June 30, to 61.35 million pounds ($18 million) from 34.07 million in the previous year.
Shares in the partially privatised company have been rising sharply on the Egyptian stock exchange. They closed the trading week on Thursday at 500.00 pounds a share.
